profiles.name: Wee Jeck Seng
profiles.description: Wee Jeck Seng represents Tanjung Piai, Johor, in the Dewan Rakyat. Affiliated with MCA.

profiles.name: Suhaili Abdul Rahman
profiles.description: Suhaili Abdul Rahman represents Labuan, Labuan, in the Dewan Rakyat. An independent MP supporting the federal government.
profiles.affiliation_note: Independent MP supporting the government; the October CSA is separate from party membership and does not prove a subsequent budget vote.

profiles.name: Verdon Bahanda
profiles.description: Verdon Bahanda represents Kudat, Sabah, in the Dewan Rakyat. Parliament lists him as independent; no party or federal bloc is assigned in this review.
profiles.affiliation_note: Parliament lists BEBAS and the August report identifies him as independent. Reported negotiations about joining BN are not a completed membership change. A current federal government/opposition commitment was not established, so bloc and party remain unassigned.

milestones.title: Support Supply Bill 2027 under the confidence-and-supply agreement
milestones.description: Signed the agreement committing support for the 2027 Supply Bill.
milestones.progress_note: The agreement is documented. A subsequent budget vote or final passage was not established in this pass; signing is not counted as delivery of the bill or joining another party.

methodology: Commitments, documented activities and limited delivery reports are distinct. Evidence-only records have no invented earlier promise. Achieved covers the described handover, programme session or launch only. Shared agency responsibility, historical dates, count units, source limitations and missing follow-up evidence are explicit. No claim of exhaustive research is made.
